en.headline: Six people assault woman with hammers and steal cash and phone in To Kwa Wan
en.dek: A 43-year-old woman was injured in the hands and feet after being attacked at her flat on Wing Yiu Street this morning; police are hunting the suspects who knew her.
body: Police are investigating an assault and theft at a tenement flat on 3 Wing Yiu Street in To Kwa Wan on Saturday morning.

At about 7:05am, six people — three men and three women — knocked on the door of a third-floor unit. After the 43-year-old woman opened the door, one man hit her with a hammer while three women tripped her. The group then took HK$3,000 in cash and a mobile phone before fleeing.

The woman suffered bruises to her hands and feet and was taken by ambulance to Queen Elizabeth Hospital. Police said the victim knew the suspects and that there had been a prior dispute. Kowloon City District Crime Squad is following up and seeking the suspects. No arrests have been reported.

zh.headline: 土瓜灣唐樓女子遭六人持錘施襲 掠走三千元及手機
zh.dek: 今早約七時永耀街一單位女住戶被認識人士持錘毆打，手腳受傷送伊利沙伯醫院，警方列襲擊及盜竊追查。
body: 警方正調查土瓜灣永耀街3號一唐樓今早發生的襲擊及盜竊案。
約上午七時零五分，三男三女前往三樓一單位敲門。四十三歲女住戶應門後，其中一名男子持錘襲擊她，另外三名女子則將她絆倒。眾人其後掠走三千元現金及一部手機後逃去。
女事主手腳擦傷，由救護車送往伊利沙伯醫院治理。警方指女事主與涉案人士認識，早前曾經發生糾紛。九龍城警區刑事調查隊正跟進案件，追絹涉案男女，暫未有人被捕。
